name: Freshly Baked San Francisco Sourdough Bread Loaf (Sliced)
whyItWorks: Authentic long-fermented sourdough made with flour, water, salt, and wild yeast culture. The fermentation process partially breaks down wheat proteins and starches, making it easier to tolerate than non-fermented commercial breads.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a fresh loaf or bread slices. Enjoy plain or with a light smear of butter. Discard any overly hard crust pieces.
